verdict.rationale: Claude Design docs mention applying a team's design system automatically to projects and syncing a design system from Claude Code via '/design-sync', suggesting some cross-project consistency mechanism, but there's no evidence of a true shared-library publish/subscribe model with version control or controlled update propagation when a source component changes. missing for 10: explicit publish workflow for shared components/styles, cross-file library linking, update notifications/controls when source changes, independent confirmation of this workflow.
